notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAobjectInstancesUpdated value. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. Two successful receive-order Update Attribute Values invocations to one object are checked as one distinct updated instance; an update to a second object advances the value to two. After a direct baseline, periodic HLAsetTiming reporting is enabled and a third object is updated twice; its periodic and direct values must both be three. Each application invocation is correlated with one ordinary reflection callback. The FOM uses no DDM regions, and the test makes no DDM-accounting claim. No provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics are used.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM value requests, object-class publication/subscription, object registration and receive-order attribute updates, HLAsetTiming control, with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
